reader_answers.task: Follow named Roman recension and explain a concrete local change.
reader_answers.answer: The Rome 1570 Ordo gives the blessing instruction and formula without an explicit count or separate solemn/pontifical qualification at that locus. Rome 1604 adds an explicit single blessing including solemn Mass, with a separate three-blessing provision for pontifical Mass.
loci: Rome 1570 printed p.291, scan174 right after Placeat
Rome 1604 printed p.259 / PDF357 right after Placeat
reader_answers.parentage: Historical parentage established; Git ancestry and text inheritance false.
reader_answers.limits: The earlier 1570 Ritus already provides a single ordinary blessing. This bounded Ordo expansion does not establish first introduction, an exhaustive Clementine delta, or the Venice1570 wording as Roman before-text. Roman1570 whole-book coverage remains partial and1604 not-transcribed.

reader_answers.task: Follow named Cistercian recension and distinguish supported changes from succession.
reader_answers.sequence: 1487 corrected missal to1606 Romanizing missal to1657 further Roman correction.
reader_answers.answer: The list visibly gives all three publication states. The1487-to1606 Memento comparison adds all the faithful and explicit offering on behalf of those remembered, but parentage remains unestablished. The1606-to1657 Orate drops pro me peccatore, pariter and in conspectu; Dominus sit in corde tuo is replaced by the Suscipiat Dominus response with minister/self alternatives. The detail also identifies expanded Confiteor, changed/relocated Suscipe Trinitas, a bounded Holy Saturday change and a paired Pentecost Sunday example.
loci: 1487 BSB canvas225 right;1606 printed190–191 / BSB244–245 for Memento
1606 printed181 right / BSBcanvas235;1657 printed174 right / FIDES0236 for Orate
reader_answers.parentage: 1487-to1606 unestablished;1606-to1657 attributed institutional revision, not proof a particular1606 copy was the typesetter exemplar. Both Git ancestry and text inheritance false.
reader_answers.text_status: 1487 not-transcribed;1606 and1657 partial whole books. The complete declared offertory constituents have7 and25 native units respectively; these are bounded functional extents, not complete books or complete Ordinaries.
reader_answers.limits: All four linked Cistercian comparison routes were actually reached. Local prayer/rubric comparisons and Holy Saturday excerpt do not exhaust calendar, chant or lectionary changes. Mandate, publication, reception and first introduction remain distinct.

reader_answers.task: Distinguish uncertain dates from duration and independent text coverage.
reader_answers.answer: Mainz MsBarth118 is positioned by the1030–1070 catalogue copying estimate, explicitly not years of use; only the summer part is identified and its later-print relationship remains unproved. Greek Hieratikon distinguishes the1950 title-year from printing completed March1952 and uses1952 publication placement; this does not establish territorial Greek/Melkite reception. Ruthenian1941 attestation/implementation is distinguished from the underlying1940 book. These documented states can remain not-transcribed, independently of their historical evidence.
